newsitem.title: CANADA: Sask Pool hog unit share offer gets nod.
newsitem.headline: Sask Pool hog unit share offer gets nod.

text.p: An initial public offering prospectus to create Manitou Hog Enterprises Ltd received final approval from the Saskatchewan Securities Commission, Saskatchewan Wheat Pool livestock unit Heartland Livestock Services said on Monday.
The approval allows 13,000 limited partnership units to be sold in Manitou Hog Enterprises Ltd.
The partnership was created to build and run a 2,400 farrow-to-finish hog production business at sites in northwest Saskatchewan.
The project's cost could be up to C$12.5 million.
Heartland was expected to provide up to C$3.25 million to the project. The balance of the financing should come from private investors and debt financing.
Heartland was established in 1994. The full-service marketing firm had sales of C$80 million last year.
